short: The first step inside: a phishing email, a stolen password, a vulnerable service.
analogy: Walks in through an unlocked window, or talks someone into opening the door.

solutionNotes.edr: Stops a malicious file or process the moment it first runs.
solutionNotes.mfa: A stolen VPN or email password no longer opens the door by itself.
solutionNotes.vm: Closes vulnerabilities on the perimeter before an attacker finds them.
solutionNotes.siem: Pulls logins and email and perimeter alerts into one picture of the first step of an attack.
solutionNotes.ngfw: Blocks attacks on exposed services and malicious websites.
solutionNotes.caasm: Shows forgotten servers, accounts and devices — the typical “unlocked windows.”
solutionNotes.easm: Shows what of yours is exposed to the internet — that’s exactly where attackers strike first.
solutionNotes.email: Catches phishing emails before anyone opens them.
solutionNotes.awareness: Employees won’t open a suspicious email and will report it.
solutionNotes.waf: Blocks attacks on websites and web applications.
solutionNotes.dast: Finds vulnerabilities in your own websites before someone exploits them.
solutionNotes.soar: Automatically handles phishing reports and deletes the same emails from every mailbox.
